description: Global Biodiversity Information Facility (GBIF) is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by USGS Science Analytics and Synthesis. Check locations where plant and animal species have been documented in the United States and Canada. This database can support scientific, educational, and policy-making activities regarding species occurrence and distribution. Users can query millions of primary records of plant and animal species by name, range, state, county, or data record provider. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems. Assets: Economy, Forestry, Natural Areas and Wildlife. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
